name: Who is allowed to do what
summary: Roles and permissions, so an ordinary member cannot do the things only an owner should.

provenance.source: SimpleHire — its admin permission model, in particular checking the permission rather than the role name at the point of use
provenance.changes: Reduced to a single declarative matrix so the whole permission model can be read on one screen and tested exhaustively.

extensionPoints.description: Your own routes and pages. Put a requirePermission() check at the top of anything that needs one.

postInstall: Decide which of your actions need a permission, and put a requirePermission() check at the top of each one.
limitations: Three fixed roles. No custom roles you can define at runtime.
Permissions apply to the whole organisation. There is no per-record sharing.
solves: only admins can do certain things
control who is allowed to delete
roles like owner admin and member
